violations.text: (A) At least 1 service sink or 1 curbed cleaning facility equipped with a floor drain shall be provided and conveniently located for the cleaning of mops or similar wet floor cleaning tools and for the disposal of mop water and similar liquid waste. (B) Toilets and urinals may not be used as a service sink for the disposal of mop water and similar liquid waste. New Violation. Correct By: 07/31/2026
The non-food contact surfaces of the beverage cooler shelves and back inside surface have an accumulation of biofilm. New Violation. Correct By: 11/02/2023
The receptacle in the women's toilet room is lacking a cover. A toilet room used by females shall be provided with a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 11/02/2023

The floors under food racks and refrigeration units have an accumulation of soil residue and/or dust. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 11/02/2023
